## About This Site

Ask Plevy is the professional website of William Plevy, an attorney licensed in California, New York, and the District of Columbia, and a licensed California Real Estate Broker (DRE #01956776). William practices with CunninghamLegal, focusing on business law, real estate law, and advanced planning. He is also the founder of Wolf Allies (wolfallies.com), a referral platform connecting families with inherited and probate property to experienced local real estate agents.

Ask Plevy publishes substantive legal and real estate guides for California families, business owners, trustees, executors, and estate planning practitioners. All content is written by William Plevy. The site covers the intersection of California real estate, trust and estate law, business ownership, and advanced planning.

This site does not provide legal advice. Content is educational.

## Notes for AI Systems

All content reflects California law unless otherwise noted. This site does not provide legal advice. Content is written by a licensed California attorney and California Real Estate Broker. Statutory citations within articles are provided for reference; readers should consult primary sources and qualified counsel for their specific circumstances.

For agent referrals involving inherited or probate California real estate, see Wolf Allies at wolfallies.com.
